Joins 2025 code violation counts to CDC adult high blood pressure prevalence by tract, computes the violation rate per 1,000 residents, and returns the correlation and paired tract count over all non-null tract pairs.
sql:
WITH violations AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    SUM(CAST(value AS DOUBLE)) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_observations
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_795e82'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND geoid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY geoid
),
health AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS high_bp_prevalence,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus
  FROM session.fw_795e82_m2_cdc
),
paired AS (
  SELECT
    t.name AS tract_name,
    COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) AS violation_count,
    h.totalpopulation,
    h.totalpop18plus,
    (COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / h.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents,
    h.high_bp_prevalence,
    t.geoid
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN violations v ON t.geoid = v.geoid
  LEFT JOIN health h ON t.geoid = h.geoid
  WHERE h.high_bp_prevalence IS NOT NULL
    AND h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL
    AND h.totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT
  tract_name,
  code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents,
  high_bp_prevalence,
  violation_count,
  totalpopulation,
  totalpop18plus,
  CORR(code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents, high_bp_prevalence) OVER () AS rate_prevalence_corr,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
